drafts.title: Clarify accessibility hardware note and referenced standard
drafts.observation: General Note 5 states: “REPLACE OR ADD ADA COMPLAINT HARDWARE ON ALL DOORS ALONG ADA ACCESSIBLE ROUTE. SEE SHEET A-1.03 FOR SCHEDULE.” The word “COMPLAINT” appears inconsistent with the intended term “COMPLIANT.” The same note block references “ICC/ANSI A117.1-2003” for accessibility reach-range requirements.
drafts.drawing_evidence: In the General Notes area at the lower left, Note 5 reads “ADA COMPLAINT HARDWARE”; Note 4 references “ACCESSIBILITY REACH RANGE REQUIREMENTS (ICC/ANSI A117.1-2003).”
drafts.drawing_location: General Notes, lower-left portion of sheet, Notes 4 and 5.
drafts.recommendation: Correct the apparent “COMPLAINT” typographical error and confirm that the referenced accessibility standard and the door-hardware schedule on A-1.03 are the standards intended for this permit set. A-1.03 is listed in the submitted sheet index but was not reviewed.
